editorial.blurb: Chicago Ramen crafts deeply flavorful, thoughtfully prepared bowls in a warm, welcoming space where every detail—from al dente noodles to rich, carefully constructed broths—shows genuine care.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the red miso ramen and customize your spice level with the chili and garlic add-ons at the table; come for lunch on weekdays for quick, attentive service.

topDishes.note: Rich, creamy broth with a spicy hint and noodles that absorb flavor beautifully
Fun, customizable style with tender pork and the ability to adjust spice and garlic to taste
